notes: Independent answers produced without reading data/questions/** or content-cards. Only reviews/blind/E.json was consulted. No official answers or explanations were viewed.

answers.rationale: HLO dot with lhs_contracting_dims={1}, rhs_contracting_dims={0} is a standard matmul; ROOT r = add(d,C) is elementwise bias add.
IREE is MLIR-based, lowers StableHLO/linalg/tosa to a .vmfb VM module + device artifacts, executes via HAL with multiple backends.
IREE compiler is AOT and heavy; runtime is small/embeddable so edge devices need not host MLIR.
Fragment 1 is affine (bounds/indices are affine in IVs+symbols). Fragment 2 uses %kidx from memref.load as an upper bound => data-dependent, not a symbol, violating affine.for constraints.
applyFullConversion requires every remaining op to be legal; otherwise verification fails. A/B/D misstate framework semantics.
Trait = compile-time metadata; Interface = virtual dispatch on Ops; Dialect = namespace grouping ops/types/attrs. C is false (Ops can be aliased/lowered via interfaces).

blocks(4,1,1) x threads(256,1,1) = 1024 threads; %arg in memspace 1 is global (per gpu-to-nvvm convention: 0=private on nvvm? actually memspace convention in gpu dialect: 0 global, 3 workgroup); real bug is missing *blockDim in the index expression, causing all blocks to read the same 256 elements.
iterator_types [parallel,parallel,reduction] with maps (m,k)/(k,n)/(m,n) and body mulf+addf into C = classic matmul with accumulation.
strided<[8,1], offset:0> with shape 4x8 => row-major, [i,j] at i*8+j elements from base; memspace 3 = GPU workgroup/shared under gpu dialect convention.
Operation may contain Regions -> Regions have Blocks (CFG). Values are SSA runtime; Attributes are compile-time metadata on ops.
Passes are op-scoped; PassManager supports nested pipelines (e.g., func.func nested in ModuleOp).
Canonicalizer + arith folders: add-zero, mul-one, sub %x,%x -> 0, unused constants DCE'd; -canonicalize is fixed-point + folds + DCE.

tensor = value type; memref = buffer with aliasing; vector = SIMD lane register type, used as primary target before LLVM lowering (tensors need bufferization first). A is false — bufferization is essential, they are not interchangeable.
ONNX is a portable model format; execution efficiency is runtime-dependent; C and D confuse interchange with runtime.
Model declares opset_import version; each op's semantics tied to declared opset version.
ONNX supports symbolic (named) dynamic dims; onnx.shape_inference propagates; unresolved dims stay symbolic.
IR version = ModelProto schema; opset version = operator semantics; independent; model declares both.
StableHLO is a versioned op set with formal spec = portability contract between frameworks and compilers, with fwd/bwd compat.
Decouples framework and compiler release cycles; avoids O(F x C) integration; supports shared optimization work.
BYOC / extern-op lowers a Relax op to an opaque call into a library; compiler treats it as black box for fusion/scheduling but still tracks shape/dtype at graph level.

Graph-level fusion in Relax + loop-level fusion in TensorIR (compute_inline / reverse_compute_at) are both correct. C over-generalizes (there are boundaries), D false (external calls stay opaque, cannot be inlined as loop bodies).
MetaSchedule: rule-based space expansion over TensorIR + cost model + real measurement + iterative search.
Relax: first-class symbolic/dynamic shapes, cross-level (graph<->PrimFunc), Python-native metaprogramming.

B (bind without prior split is valid legalization if extent fits), C (split+bind canonical vector-add), D (cache_read with 'shared' scope). A is wrong — vectorize can legitimately fail (verifier error), not silently scalar.
PrimFunc is loop-level tensor program with explicit blocks/iters/buffers; schedule primitives transform loop structure without changing compute semantics.
Relax VM = bytecode runtime dispatching PrimFunc / external calls / control flow, plus dynamic-shape allocation & object lifetime.
Buffer assignment maps HLO values to buffers; disjoint-liveness values share buffers; in-place chosen when input's use is provably last.

XLA fusion kinds (loop/input/output); output-fusion of elementwise+reduction avoids intermediate materialization. C false (there are cost-based boundaries), D false (fusion has compiler-side kFusion HloInstruction representation).
StableHLO dynamic_* ops (A), bucketing/padding for serving (C), static-first orientation with per-shape recompilation (D). B false — HLO retains shape annotations.
GSPMD: sharding-annotated HLO rewritten into per-device program with inserted collectives (all-reduce/all-gather/reshard).
